paper-cream.$description: Paper Cream — Page canvas, the continuous warm background behind every section — the paper the whole product sits on

sand-border.$description: Sand Border — Hairline borders, soft card surfaces that float just barely above the cream canvas, subtle dividers

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, masthead headlines, and the near-black ink that gives the editorial type its printed authority

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body copy, secondary text, and any UI text that needs to stay just slightly softer than pure ink

stone.$description: Stone — Muted helper text, inactive icons, and the soft gray that recedes behind primary content

slate-border.$description: Slate Border — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-stone.$description: Deep Stone — Pressed/hover states for borders and link underlines — a half-step darker than Slate Border

amber-honey.$description: Amber Honey — Decorative brand accent — brand mark, active workspace icon stroke, highlight tag dots. Rationed: never fills a button, never carries body text

gt-pressura-standard.$description: Display and headline voice — masthead, section titles, oversized declarations. Its geometric, slightly industrial forms at 104–136px are the brand's signature, replacing the typical bold sans headline with something that reads more like editorial typography set by hand.

inter.$description: Body, UI, navigation, badges, and supporting headlines. Quiet, high-legibility workhorse that stays out of GT Pressura's way; the 0.214em tracking on 10–14px uppercase labels is the second signature — small editorial micro-labels that read as typeset marginalia.
